snippet.title: The Telephone - OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
The Telephone is a first-person psychological horror game that will immerse you in a world ruled by anxiety. You'll need to explore the house where you're trapped and the mysterious town of Lonely Plain, searching for clues that can help Roberta regain her memory.
